articles.title: Goodbye Forever: 'Living Plastic' Self-Destructs in 6 Days, No Microplastics Left Behind
articles.summary: Engineered 'living plastic' harbors dormant bacteria that, when awakened by warm nutrients, produce two enzymes to fully degrade the material in 6 days. The process avoids microplastic formation. A wearable electrode made from it disappeared in two weeks.

articles.title: Countdown to History: India's First Private Orbital Rocket Set to Launch
articles.summary: Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1, India's first privately developed orbital rocket, is scheduled to lift off July 18 from Sriharikota. The 7-story, 4-stage vehicle will carry a debris-capturing robotic arm, a tech demo, and symbolic payloads on its test flight.

articles.title: A Camera That Sees the Invisible: 3D Tracking of Ghost Particles
articles.summary: ETH Zurich and EPFL researchers built a prototype detector that uses light field camera technology to track particles in 3D inside a single block of scintillator. It avoids the need for millions of segmented cubes, potentially slashing costs for neutrino and dark matter experiments.
